bug_semantics: CWE-436 interpretation conflict on the Backfill API: requires_access_backfill parsed path backfill_id with int() and swallowed ValueError, while the routes declare pydantic NonNegativeInt (lax mode accepts 1.0 / 1.00 as 1). FastAPI runs the dependency before endpoint validation, so those spellings left dag_id unresolved and authorized against a caller-supplied body or query dag_id, then the handler acted on the coerced backfill. An authenticated user with DAG-edit on any one Dag could read, pause, or cancel another Dag's backfills, including failing queued runs. Sequential ids; no non-default config.
